what_it_is.value: BarcodeWake is an alarm clock that can require a physical mission, such as scanning a saved barcode or QR code, before dismissal.
what_it_is.evidence: The alarm editor configures mission type, difficulty and completion requirements.

core_measurement.value: The app schedules alarms and verifies a selected scan, maths, typing, shake or step mission; it does not measure sleep stages.
core_measurement.evidence: MissionType contains barcode, qr, math, typing, shake and steps.

offline.value: Alarm setup, local mission verification and stored app data work on the device. The privacy policy says optional telemetry is disabled by default.
offline.evidence: The English privacy section describes local processing and the telemetry default.

account_required.value: No BarcodeWake account or sign-in is required for the documented alarm and mission features.
account_required.evidence: The app has no account, authentication or cloud-backend flow.

ads_tracking.value: The source project has no advertising SDK dependency. Optional telemetry is presented as off by default in the privacy policy.
ads_tracking.evidence: No mobile ads package is declared; the policy documents the telemetry switch.

data_storage.value: Alarm settings, history and preferences are stored locally. Registered barcode, QR and NFC values use SHA-256 hashes in current storage and exchange paths.
data_storage.evidence: The Drift layer is local and data exchange hashes raw values when importing older data.

export_formats.value: The current source supports JSON backup, a printable PDF backup barcode and a code-free setup QR for sharing a limited alarm configuration.
export_formats.evidence: DataExchangeService emits JSON schema version 3 and PDF; ShareSetupService emits setup QR payloads.

accuracy_limits.value: BarcodeWake is an alarm utility, not a medical device or sleep tracker. Delivery depends on operating-system permissions, battery controls and device-vendor behaviour.
accuracy_limits.evidence: The app includes reliability diagnostics and no sleep-stage sensing.

hardware_requirements.value: Barcode and QR use the camera; shake uses motion sensing; steps require step-count support; NFC requires compatible hardware. Alarm delivery needs relevant notification and exact-alarm permissions.
hardware_requirements.evidence: The manifests and plugins declare camera, sensors, NFC and alarm capabilities.

known_limitations.value: There is no cloud sync, account system or sleep-stage analysis. Setup sharing omits saved codes, NFC identifiers, PINs and history. Google Play showed version 1.0.0 when checked; the repository reports source version 2.0.0+2, which is not claimed as published.
known_limitations.evidence: The service excludes secrets; the store snapshot and pubspec report different versions.

features.name: Barcode and QR missions
features.summary: Require a registered physical code before dismissal.
features.limits: Camera or compatible NFC hardware is required for the selected code type.

features.name: Challenge missions
features.summary: Use maths, typing, shake or step tasks instead of a saved code.
features.limits: Sensor-dependent missions require device support and permissions.

features.name: Mission chains
features.summary: Combine multiple missions in a fixed chain or select one randomly.
features.limits: Store availability depends on the published app version.

features.name: Local backup and setup sharing
features.summary: Export local data and share a limited alarm setup without registered secrets.
features.limits: A setup QR contains at most six alarms and omits codes, NFC identifiers, PINs and history.

features.name: Reliability Doctor
features.summary: Checks configuration that can prevent dependable alarm delivery.
features.limits: It cannot override vendor battery management or operating-system restrictions.

not_supported.name: Cloud sync
not_supported.reason: The documented data model is local and has no cloud account backend.

not_supported.name: Sleep-stage tracking
not_supported.reason: The app schedules alarms but does not classify sleep stages.

not_supported.name: Public iOS availability claim
not_supported.reason: No verified App Store listing was available during this audit.

not_supported.name: Secret-bearing setup QR
not_supported.reason: Sharing excludes registered codes, NFC identifiers, PINs and history.
